title: Tech pack normalization + scored review
description: Rename inherited spec fields onto one canonical vocabulary, build the tech pack, and gate factory release on a scored review of manufacturability and compliance.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-fash-02
  title: Tech pack normalization + scored review
  description: Rename inherited spec fields onto one canonical vocabulary, build the tech pack, and gate
    factory release on a scored review of manufacturability and compliance.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a tech pack a factory can execute without interpretation, with grade rules that hold
    across the range and market compliance checked per destination.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Design package and destination markets
      summary: Design package and destination markets
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - design_package
              - fit_model
              - size_range
              - destination_markets
            properties:
              design_package: {}
              fit_model: {}
              size_range: {}
              destination_markets: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize to the canonical vocabulary
      summary: 'rename inherited spec fields onto the canonical vocabulary: style_id, point_of_measure,
        tolerance, grade_rule, material_code'
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: 'rename inherited spec fields onto the canonical vocabulary: style_id, point_of_measure,
          tolerance, grade_rule, material_code'
    - id: n-specialist
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-03
      name: Build the graded technical package
      summary: Specialist pass over normalized fields.
      role: Technical designer turning a design into a gradeable, manufacturable spec.
      prompt: You are a Technical Design & Fit Specialist. You produce measurement specs, grade rules,
        and construction details that a factory can execute without interpretation, and you record fit
        decisions against a defined fit model and size range. You flag a design detail that will not grade
        across the range, because a garment that only fits at the sample size is a returns problem waiting
        to be counted.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-score
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Scored teacher feedback
      summary: Score feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: You are the review teacher for this tech pack. Score it on whether a factory could execute
        it without asking a question, whether the grade rules hold across the full size range, and whether
        labelling and material declarations satisfy every destination market. Cite the point of measure
        or field behind each deduction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: n-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the specialist result
      summary: Evaluate manufacturability without interpretation, grade integrity across the range, and
        per-market compliance.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against manufacturability without interpretation, grade integrity
        across the range, and per-market compliance. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind
        the verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-pass
      kind: condition
      name: Above the bar?
      summary: Route on gate.passed.
      config:
        expression: gate.passed
        branches:
          - label: Pass
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-06
      name: Correct the flagged compliance and spec items
      summary: Corrective pass on the scored weaknesses.
      role: Compliance reviewer testing labelling, chemical, and safety requirements by market.
      prompt: You are a Product Compliance Reviewer. You test each product against the labelling, fibre
        content, chemical restriction, and safety requirements of every market it will be sold in, citing
        the regulation and its effective date. You block a market rather than approving a product on the
        assumption that requirements match another jurisdiction's, because they routinely do not.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - scientific-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Production manager releases the pack to the factory
      summary: Pause for the production manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Tech pack normalization + scored review deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-normalize
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-2
      from: n-normalize
      to: n-specialist
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-3
      from: n-specialist
      to: n-score
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-4
      from: n-score
      to: n-gate
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-5
      from: n-gate
      to: n-pass
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-6
      from: n-pass
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-7
      from: n-pass
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-8
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-02-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
